featured_reviews.name: Pooja Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text: "I purchased two pairs of washable shoes from your store, which became completely damaged after the first wash. Despite the shoes being under the 3-month warranty period, Mr. Vijay Devendra, the store manager, refused to honor the warranty and did not provide a refund or replacement. Furthermore, his conduct toward me was unprofessional and discourteous, causing inconvenience and distress. I request that this matter be addressed promptly and appropriate corrective action be taken. I also urge the management to review customer service practices at this store to prevent similar issues in the future."
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
We take all customer concerns seriously and would like to clarify the facts regarding this matter.

The shoes mentioned in your review were brought to the store after they were washed by you. As per company policy, all such cases must be sent to the brand for inspection and approval before any exchange can be processed. This is not an immediate in store decision and requires confirmation from the company.

For transparency, a request for approval was sent on 19th January, and the exchange approval was received from the company on 24th January. As soon as the approval came, you visited the store and the shoes were exchanged accordingly. It is also important to note that the brand approved this exchange as a gesture of goodwill, even though the damage was not confirmed to be a manufacturing defect.

We would also like to mention that throughout this process our staff faced repeated calls on their personal numbers, often in an aggressive manner. Our team members are always willing to assist customers, but respectful communication is equally important.

On the day you visited the store for the exchange, the store manager was not present, yet our team still ensured that the approved exchange was completed smoothly.

We value every customer and always follow company guidelines while handling warranty claims. We hope this clarifies the timeline and the efforts made by our team to resolve the issue.

Regards, 
Unity Sports Parel.

Any person with cricketing knowledge would understand that the knocking wasnt done. However the manager insists that the knocking was perfect.

Sad that a store this good has to lose out on repeat customers due to the laziness of some employees.

Update: Good to know that not only the service is sub standard but the owner considers all buyers illiterate about the sport. I recognize a well knocked bat when I see one. featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Sir,
  I am great to know that you had detailed look on bat. 
i would like to explain you our process of knoking and the bat behaviour.
We start with Hammer knocking for 2 days then it goes to hanging ball knocking , by this time the bat has got used to the force and impact of the ball and it gets compressed.

The bat will show the mark till it get compressed, once it gets fully compressed you wont find the dent mark of the ball as now there is no space for the wood to compress, and at last for knokcing we use throwdown .

I am sure that you bat will be knocked and since you saw the dent it means they are compressed well.

Trust us we are trying our best to remove many myths about cricket.
I am happy that you brought this thing which also ensure that my team has knocked the bat well for you

For any query please feel to contact us and we will make sure this time you have a better experience

Sorry for the inconvinience

Thanking you

Keep up the great work!
